review_method: Manual review of synchronized table, side, and wrist contact sheets sampled every 20 seconds. Whole questionable episodes are excluded conservatively; this is not an exhaustive per-frame human annotation.
privacy_rule: Frames containing hands, people, laptops, phones, or setup activity must not be used for simulator appearance fitting, background extraction, or model training.

excluded_human_or_setup.reason: Brief human intrusions were observed; exclude the whole episode unless it is exhaustively re-annotated.
Hands, a person, a laptop, and manual object rearrangement appear in several portions.
Person, hands, laptop, phone, and setup activity occur throughout.
Hands and manual object removal/setup activity are visible.
A hand intervention was observed near 360 seconds; the tail is excluded conservatively.

limitations: Twenty-second review sampling can miss short intrusions between reviewed frames.
Before model training or publication, run a finer privacy review or an approved privacy scrub.
Human-free does not mean object-free: cubes, bins, cables, robot, and fixtures must still be masked for background extraction.
Use whole episodes for train/validation splitting to prevent temporal leakage.
